features.name: co2_impact_index
features.description: Standardized measure of a material's environmental impact, combining CO2 emissions, biodegradation speed, and recyclability.

features.name: cost_efficiency_index
features.description: Economic feasibility score combining material cost, a durability proxy, and recyclability bonus.

features.name: material_suitability_score
features.description: General robustness profile of a material across load, moisture, and thermal handling conditions. Represents material-level suitability; per-product matching against fragility_index and shipping_type happens separately in the recommendation engine (Module 4).
